### Working Families Built This City.
### They Deserve to Stay Here.
I'm Michael Nguyen—son of refugees, renter, community organizer for 20 years, I’m also known as Juicy Liu in drag—and I'm running for District 8 Supervisor to fight for everyday people being left behind.
You deserve a supervisor who represents YOU, not special interests. I understand your struggles because I've lived them. I will fight for:
Affordability
Expand Free MUNI for Youth/Seniors
Enhance rent stabilization
Make big corporations pay their fair share
Housing Production
Focus on building the already approved 17,000 units
Create permanent community-owned affordable housing
Innovation & Accountability
Cut fees to help small businesses thrive
Protect essential checks & balances in City Hall
Three ways to join our fight:
Get campaign updates – Be first to know about events and ways to help
Make a grassroots donation – Every dollar fights for our community
Share your story – Tell me what matters most to you and your family
Let's build a District 8 where no one gets left behind.
